lines.text: Medicare.gov is blunt: "Medicare will never call you to sell you anything or visit you at your home."

post.ig:
If 'Medicare' calls to sell you a plan, it's not Medicare.
Medicare.gov: "Medicare will never call you to sell you anything or visit you at your home."
The FTC warns caller ID showing Medicare's name or number can be faked.
Open enrollment runs Oct 15 - Dec 7, 2026. People 60+ reported $7.75 billion in online crime losses to the FBI in 2025, up 59% in a year.
Sources: Medicare.gov, FTC, HHS-OIG, FBI IC3.
